SNK.eval: import('/src/world/setpieces/nicoHouse/r4/plan4.js').then((m) => { const T = game.THREE, NH = game.nicoHouse, P = m.P4, F = P.F, Tw = P.wallT; const w = (x, y, z) => { const [gx, gz] = m.toG(...m.HtoS(...m.BtoH(x, z))); return NH.toWorld(new T.Vector3(gx, NH.group.position.y * 0 + y, gz)); }; const t = ([6.5 - Tw - 0.27, F + 0.4, -4.45]), e = ([4.2, F + 1.5, -5.6]); const tgt = w(...t), eye = w(...e); game.cameraOverride = (dt, cam) => { cam.position.copy(eye); cam.up.set(0, 1, 0); cam.lookAt(tgt); if (cam.fov !== 62) { cam.fov = 62; cam.updateProjectionMatrix(); } return true; }; })
